'''Dominion''' is a blade-wielding, hound-summoning school of abilities purloined from the [[chivalry|chivalric]] traditions of traditional knighthood for the use of [[Chaos]] warriors. The spread of the skill compasses taming the hounds of [[Lycantha]], mastering the various types of [[bow]]s, and an assortment of aggressive supplemental battle abilities ranging from howling or engaging an unlucky opponent and boosting one's prowess with the fury of the eldritch horror.

The skill of '''Dominion''' is available to members of the [[Unnamable]] [[class]], although it shares most of its arts with [[Valour]], [[Discipline]], and [[Malignity]] skills of [[Paladin]]s, [[Runewardens]], and [[Infernals]]. Like the other warrior-classes, Unnamables train in [[Weaponmastery]], but the eldritch skill of [[Anathema (skill)|Anathema]] is unique to them.

==Abilities in Dominion==
{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Hound
 |description=Your loyal nightmare.
 |lessons=1
 |syntax=HOUND
 |required=
 |target=self and adventurers
 |cooldown=
 |detail=The hungering hounds of Lycantha are a gift to each of the Unnamables of Ashtan, part of the great pact between Imperator Glaaki and the Seat of Chaos.
Your hound comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned.<br>
If you cause your hound to die, you will be refused another hound.
There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your hound.<br>
Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your hound.<br>
HOUND ASSESS    : See information about your hound.<br>
HOUND RECALL : Recall your hound to your side.<br>
HOUND SANCTUARY : Order your hound to a sanctuary where it will be safe.<br>
HOUND TRAIN : Order your hound to go train, in order to raise a stat.<br>
HOUND REPORT    : Gain information on where your hound is.<br>
HOUND SLAY      : Order your hound to slay someone.<br>
HOUND HUNT : When your hound is hungry, have it go hunt for its food.<br>
HOUND FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your hound will flee battle.<br>
HOUND SLEEP     : Order your hound to sleep.<br>
HOUND FEED RAT  : Feed the corpses of rats to your hound.<br>
As your hound gains in
* Stamina:  its health will increase.
* Speed: it will attack more quickly as well as move from place to place
* Strength: it will attack with more power.
You will gain other abilities later on that are related to your hound.
You must visit Lycantha on the Chaos Plane to request your hound.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Quivers
 |description=Take full advantage of your quiver.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom><br>INSPECT QUIVER<br>DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour><br>SWITCH <colour>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver.<p>When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. </p><p>Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. </p><p>Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver.</p><p>Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver.</p><p>To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.</p>
}}
